metadata.purpose: Canonical user-confirmed common formations used as comparison baselines in formation recommendations.
metadata.policy: All legal common formations are mandatory candidate-ledger baselines for ordinary combat formation recommendations, not predetermined winners. Applicability tags describe intended strengths and affect comparison; they are not permission to omit a legal baseline. Evaluate each line under the user's actual roster, progression, troop availability, objective, and opponent. Apply the same evidence gates and comparison axes used for every other candidate. A common formation remains fully eligible to be the final recommendation when it is the best-supported line. Specialized non-combat or Siege-only requests may mark combat baselines inapplicable with an explicit reason.

formations.name: Velar / Vhagar / Moondancer
formations.strategic_basis: Common all-around high-damage formation with affinity-perfect Shieldbearers, Vhagar's directional Vanguard support, and Velar-to-Moondancer Rising Tide opportunities.
formations.source: User-confirmed common formation supplied on 2026-10-01. Mechanics require fresh validation against canonical dragon records for every recommendation.

formations.name: Vermithor / Rhysarion / Venator
formations.strategic_basis: Common damage-and-survivability formation with affinity-perfect Spearmen, Vermithor's Protect and mitigation, Rhysarion's Recovery and Vanguard support, and Venator's sustained Basic-Attack pressure.
formations.source: User-confirmed common formation supplied on 2026-10-01. Mechanics require fresh validation against canonical dragon records for every recommendation.

formations.name: Malachite / Seasmoke / Kalspire
formations.strategic_basis: Common well-rounded Cavalry formation and expert counter baseline into Velar/Vhagar/Moondancer with Shieldbearers, combining troop advantage, Malachite sustain, Seasmoke enemy-buff removal, and Kalspire pressure.
formations.source: User-confirmed common formation and counter supplied on 2026-10-01. Mechanics require fresh validation against canonical dragon records for every recommendation.
